headline: SEC Adopts Amendments Updating Small Entity Definitions for Funds
summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission adopted amendments to rules defining which registered investment companies, investment advisers, and business development companies qualify as small entities.
why: Regulatory definitions established by the SEC determine compliance obligations and reporting requirements for smaller financial institutions and investment advisers operating in the United States.

impacts.name: Investment Management
impacts.why: Rule updates alter regulatory definitions affecting registered investment companies and advisers.
